meta_description: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.

blocks.x: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.

Achala Nexus is the decision infrastructure for high-volume enterprise choices: credit, claims, pricing, triage, fraud, routing. It combines predictive models, business rules and agentic reasoning behind one governed decision API, with champion-challenger testing and full decision replay — so any decision can be reconstructed months later for an auditor, a customer or a court.

Nexus enforces separability by design: models score, policy decides, humans supervise. Risk teams change policy without retraining; data scientists ship models without touching code paths; compliance inspects what actually ran on any given day. It is the platform underneath our decision-intelligence services and the control point for every automated decision we deploy.

items: one governed entry point with SLA guarantees
versioned decision policies with effective-dating and simulation
shadow scoring and incremental traffic shifting
online feature store with point-in-time correctness

blocks.x: Nexus runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys, full audit export and evidence packs mapped to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and model-risk expectations. Decision policies, model versions and feature states are immutable artifacts — the replay trail is cryptographic, not testimonial.

items: every artifact the platform produces doubles as audit evidence — no reconstruction projects.
teams start at pattern 80% and spend their budget on the 20% that is genuinely yours.
named control owner per deployment; platform telemetry makes the owner's job inspectable.

blocks.x: Most programs deploy Achala Nexus inside the customer's landing zone with a Achala pod operating it through a named run model, then transfer operations to client teams once the SLOs have held for two quarters.
Certified integration surface: Databricks Feature Store, Kafka/Flink, Redis, OPA, core-system adapters.
Primary industry deployments: Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Retail & Consumer Goods, Energy & Utilities, Logistics & Supply Chain.
